  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots in the immediate aftermath of price spikes (e.g., 1-3 days post-peak).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 10-day average, reduce by 5-15%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is negative (e.g., < 0.00).",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility; smooth forecasts using 7-day moving average filter.",
    "If sentiment is positive (e.g., > 0.25), slightly increase forecast but cap at 10% above recent high.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is rising faster than forecast, adjust next period’s forecast upward by 2-5%."
  ]
}
